name: PRISM 800m Meteorology Variables - ZCTA Yearly
description: ZCTA-level yearly summaries of daily population-weighted PRISM 800-meter meteorological variables. Yearly values are computed as annual means of the daily ZCTA-level estimates.

content.year: Int64: Year of the PRISM estimates
content.tmax_C: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily maximum temperature (deg C)
content.tmin_C: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily minimum temperature (deg C)
content.tmean_C: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily mean temperature (deg C)
content.tdmean_C: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily mean dew point temperature (deg C)
content.ppt: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily total precipitation, including rain and melted snow (mm)
content.vpdmax: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily maximum vapor pressure deficit (hPa)
content.vpdmin: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily minimum vapor pressure deficit (hPa)
content.solslope: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily global shortwave solar radiation on a sloped surface (MJ m-2 day-1)
content.soltotal: Float64: Annual mean of population-weighted daily global shortwave solar radiation on a horizontal surface (MJ m-2 day-1)
